_meta.purpose: Track per-skill quality scores across invocations

scoring_rubric.10: Flawless — perfect execution, exceeded expectations, zero rework
scoring_rubric.9: Excellent — all success criteria met, minimal polish
scoring_rubric.8: Strong — correct execution, minor adjustments only
scoring_rubric.7: Good — correct, one small correction needed

_meta.update_instructions:
Append to runs[] after each non-trivial invocation. Recompute average_score. Update last_updated.

Run entry schema:
{
  "run_id": "<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ>-<6hex>",
  "session_id": "<env:CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID or 'unknown'>",
  "timestamp": "<ISO-8601>",
  "invocation_trigger": "claude-proactive",
  "arguments": "<args string>",
  "score": null,
  "outcome": null,
  "duration_ms": <int>,
  "trace": {
    "output_length_tokens": null,
    "tool_calls_made": [],
    "final_lines": "<last 300 chars of output>",
    "failure_reason": null
  },
  "human_review": {
    "scored_at": null,
    "correction": null,
    "note": null
  }
}

Score with: /score-skill --skill <name>  |  Optimize: /optimize-skill --skill <name> (needs 10+ scored runs)

description: Generator skill — scaffolds dbt model SQL with source/ref macros and schema.yml test stubs for staging, intermediate, or marts layers.
